summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time field, finished property, capture/clear logic in update/advance/reset and Task._reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with local imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entries, including one for Palette.__rich__ beyond the spec); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn, expected output regenerated by hand-tracing the clock). Not run: test_columns could not be executed under the no-run rule, so its expected text is derived from a clock trace. Mechanical checks passed: bar runs are 25 wide in start frames and 16 in finished frames, and every table row measures 80 visible characters. Choices: palette headers are Index, RGB, Color; RGB cell is an f-string "(r, g, b)". tests/test_columns.py was left unchanged because it tests Columns, not progress columns.
